1. Name this phone
Your computer lists this name beside every Entry that comes from here, so pick something you will recognise later.

Pixel in my pocket

Open Sharepaste on the computer you are already paired to and choose Pair a device. Point this phone at the square code it shows.
Name this phone first — the code is only good for two minutes, so we would rather ask now than lose it.

Your computer prints the code underneath the square, in groups of four. Upper or lower case, dashes or not — it does not matter.

Sharepaste cannot use the camera, so it cannot read the square code. You can turn camera access on in Settings, or type the code underneath the square instead — that works just as well.
This phone has no camera Sharepaste can use, so there is nothing to point at the square code. Type the code printed underneath it instead.
That code has already expired. A pairing code is only good for two minutes, on purpose — anyone who reads it over your shoulder can pair with it. Ask your computer for a fresh one and scan again.
That is not a Sharepaste pairing code. Check you scanned the square on the Pair a device screen, or retype the code underneath it.
Your computer\u2019s Relay turned this phone away. The code may already have been used by another device — ask for a fresh one.
Sharepaste could not reach the Relay. Check this phone has a working connection, then try the code again — you have two minutes from when your computer showed it.
That code points at a Relay served over plain http://. Sharepaste will not send this phone\u2019s access token over a connection anyone on the network can read, so it refused before connecting.

resources.string: Sharepaste only looks for new Entries while this app is open. It does no work in the background — that is deliberate, and it is why nothing here drains your battery or reads your clipboard behind your back. Something you copied on the computer an hour ago arrives the moment you open Sharepaste, not before.
Checking for new Entries\u2026

About this phone

This phone told the Relay its name when it paired, and that is the name every other device sees beside your Entries. It cannot be changed afterwards — pair this phone again to give it a different one.

Your computer has two switches this phone does not. Sharepaste never watches this phone\u2019s clipboard — it only ever sends what you hand it — so there is nothing to turn on, and no list of apps to keep it away from.
